answer:
Your Reading log now has a page, under the Page tab in the note. I didn't open it in the app, so I haven't seen how it looks.

- **Cover cards:** each book is a tall card with a colour gradient and its title and author on the cover. The rating stars and finish date sit underneath, newest first. There are no real cover images, so the colour comes from the title.
- **Stats:** total books, books finished this year, and your average rating.
- **Books per month:** a bar chart of the last six months.
- **Log a book:** a small form on the page that adds a row to your table.
- **Want to read:** a section that shows only if the note has a checklist.

The table itself is unchanged.
